intro.text: The carpenter of Hearthstone, who took over the trade from his father.

items.text: Ral learned carpentry from his father and succeeded him as Hearthstone's carpenter in 1166. In Roshone's second year as citylord he took on Tien, though he had little need of help, and that same year he was disappointed that Tien kept getting distracted by projects that served no use.
